audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads EVEN with a red tone, difficulty 7/10 and 'Hard matchup', against 54.65% over 249 games and a whys[6] that says 'You hold the clear edge'.
audit.why: The level chart, the win rate and the closing why all describe a lane Mordekaiser wins from 2 onward. The rating prose is the outlier.
audit.corrected: Level chart corrected to the mirror's reading; the numeric difficulty prose left alone pending a human call — flagged in questionsForUser rather than half-rewritten across four coupled strings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows were wrong on both layers — the page gave Kennen Levels 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items, and gave Mordekaiser Level 1.
audit.why: The mirror set L1 Kennen, L2-L3 Mordekaiser, Levels 4-5 Skill, L6 Mordekaiser, first item Mordekaiser, 2+ items Mordekaiser. The whys text already agrees with the mirror: whys[0] says you cannot punish his shuriken poke at 1, whys[1] says you bully at 2-3, whys[3] calls 4-5 even, whys[5] and whys[6] both hand you the item windows. The packet chart has row 0 as Skill; I followed the mirror and the whys text, which both say Kennen, since mirror-fix.js would overwrite a disagreement anyway.
audit.corrected: Rows 0,1,2,3,5,6 flipped in matched full/content pairs to Kennen, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, with ratings rescaled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lightning Rush was described as a dash and Slicing Maelstrom carried no cooldown; the Mark of the Storm stun had no counterplay attached.
audit.why: Kit file: Lightning Rush is a lightning-form change that passes through units on 10/9/8/7/6s for 80 energy — no dash, so 'burns his E dash' misreads the tell. Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s at 550 range. Thundering Shuriken is 950 range on 7/6.25/5.5/4.75/4s, and three marks stun.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, dontsFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d and the mid text now carry the real cooldowns and call Lightning Rush a form change.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization was the generic Liandry's line and never told you to buy MR in a matchup whose whole win condition line is 'build MR'.
audit.why: Electrical Surge applies on-hit magic damage every few attacks and adds a Mark, so his damage scales with attack speed — armour reads the trade wrong. Mercury's Treads also cuts the Mark of the Storm stun.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now says MR not armour and ties Mercury's Treads to the Mark stun.

edits.before: His escape. R him when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Lightning Rush is 10/9/8/7/6s — commit the moment it is spent, not before.

edits.before: Track Kennen's Lightning Rush: His escape. R him when it’s down. When it is down — R him — no escape.
edits.after: Lightning Rush is 10-6s and costs 80 energy; Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s. Commit when both are spent.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Three Marks of the Storm stun you — Mercury's Treads and spacing keep it at two.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s at 550 range and re-stuns through marks — walk out of it, or spend your R first to take him out of the fight.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion. Core: Liandry's Torment  (burn carries his extended trades), then Riftmaker; boots Mercury's Treads. First back: Lost Chapter component / Bami's (≈900-1300g).
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + Health Potion. Core: Liandry's Torment (burn beats his kite), then Riftmaker; boots Mercury's Treads for the Mark stun. Electrical Surge is on-hit magic — buy MR, not armour.

edits.before: "\"Levels 4-5 are his one real window: with W's empowered autos and energy back up he Q-pokes and kites on passive plus Lightning Rush move speed between your cooldowns, so respect that and bait his Q before you step. Then 6 is your takeover — Realm of Death rips him into a 1v1 where his R AOE stun, his peel and his kite all evaporate, and your aura plus shield simply out-DPS a squishy energy mage with no sustain. Pop R the moment he's a touch low or burns his E dash, and use your own E to glue him for the duration.\""
edits.after: "\"Levels 4-5 are his one real window: with W's empowered autos and energy back up he Q-pokes and kites on passive plus Lightning Rush move speed between your cooldowns, so respect that and bait his Q before you step. Then 6 is your takeover — Realm of Death rips him into a 1v1 where his R AOE stun, his peel and his kite all evaporate, and your aura plus shield simply out-DPS a squishy energy mage with no sustain. Pop R the moment he's a touch low or burns Lightning Rush — it is a form change on 10-6s, not a dash — and use your own E to glue him.\""

notes: The level chart was inverted on six of seven rows in both layers; fixed in matched pairs following the mirror, which agrees with the whys text. Row 0 differs from the packet chart (packet says Skill, mirror and whys[0] say Kennen) — I followed the mirror because mirror-fix.js would overwrite the other way anyway. As with the other matchups in this slice, the derived 'grounding' flag on Mordekaiser's Q is absent from Riot's Obliterate text and was not asserted.
